# T-1: Add impl review artifact

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Introduce the structured impl review finding and artifact contract used by review command output.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `impl-review.json` is written with verdict, summary, blocking findings, non-blocking improvements, and excluded scope counts.
- `review.md` renders blocking and non-blocking sections from the same normalized artifact data.
- Scope filtering applies to both finding buckets and records missing-file and out-of-scope counts.
- Missing-acceptance blockers with a valid requirement id remain blocking even when `file` is empty.

## Implementation Notes
Work mainly in `src/flow/commands/review.js`. Reuse existing JSON repair and artifact-writing helpers for JSON parsing, JSON artifact writes, and markdown review rendering. Use classes for new finding/artifact concepts if they carry invariant checks or rendering behavior.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests in `tests/unit/flow/commands/review.test.js` plus spec-local tests for R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, and R13.
